summary: Comprehensive backend API testing completed for Cartoonix streaming platform. Tested all 53 endpoints covering health, categories, avatars, authentication (registration, login, email verification), admin CRUD operations (cartoons, episodes, users), favorites, watch history, playlists (Plus-only), and MongoDB serialization. 52 out of 53 tests passed (98.1% success rate).

deployment_issues.issue: Static files return text/html instead of image content-type when accessed via public URL
deployment_issues.root_cause: Kubernetes ingress routing /uploads/* to frontend (port 3000) instead of backend (port 8001)
deployment_issues.verification: Static files work correctly on backend localhost:8001 with proper content-type: image/jpeg
deployment_issues.impact: Avatar images and uploaded files not accessible via public URL
deployment_issues.fix_required: Update Kubernetes ingress rules to route /uploads/* to backend service (port 8001)

passed_tests: Health check (GET /api/)
Categories list (GET /api/categories) - returns 3 fixed channels
Category by slug (GET /api/categories/jetix-foxkids)
Avatars list (GET /api/avatars) - returns 14 avatars
Registration: first user becomes admin automatically
Registration validations: accepted_terms, password>=6, nickname>=2, unique email, unique nickname
Email verification: wrong code returns 401, increments attempts
Resend code: throttles to 30s minimum, returns 429 if too soon
Login: returns 401 for wrong credentials, 200+token for correct
Auth/me: requires Bearer token, returns user without password_hash
Auth/me update: updates nickname, rejects duplicate nickname
Cartoons: public access works, filters by category and search query
Admin cartoons: requires admin role, validates category_id, CRUD operations work
Admin episodes: validates cartoon_id, CRUD operations work, delete cascades
Admin uploads: validates file extensions (video/thumbnail), rejects unsupported formats
Admin import-folder: rejects paths outside /app/backend/uploads
Admin users: list without password_hash, update role/subscription/email_verified, cannot delete self
Admin stats: returns all counts (users, cartoons, episodes, plus, verified) and recent items
Favorites: toggle add/remove, list, check favorited status
Watch history: record progress, list with enriched cartoon+episode data
Playlists: free users get empty list, Plus-only restrictions enforced for create/add/delete
MongoDB serialization: no ObjectId leaks, datetime fields as ISO strings
action_item_for_main_agent: One deployment issue found: Static file serving (/uploads/*) is routed to frontend instead of backend. Backend code is correct (verified on localhost:8001). This is a Kubernetes ingress configuration issue. Update ingress rules to route /uploads/* to backend service. All backend API endpoints work correctly.
